svg.aria-label: Success vs sampling steps. Lift diffusion 0, 60.5, 63.0 percent and flow matching 66, 81, 77 at 1, 5, 10 steps. Pour diffusion 27.5 at 5 and 51.5 at 50 steps; flow matching 57, 50, 41.5 at 5, 10, 50 steps
